sources.snippet: ⚗️ Catalyst‑Mini - A 10M Parameter Language Model from Scratch Catalyst‑Mini is a tiny, hackable decoder‑only Transformer language model built entirely in PyTorch. With just ~10 million parameters, it replicates the architecture of frontier models (Llama, Mistral, GPT‑4) while being small enough to train on a single GPU - even the free T4 on Google Colab.
